title: Simulation 3D Rotorcraft
text: Implement 3D Rotorcraft, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Color} sets Rotorcraft color; {Sample time}, {Type} sets the rotorcraft type Light, {Path to light helicopter mesh}, {Path to helicopter mesh}, {Path to multirotor mesh}, {Name} sets the rotorcraft name, {Initial translation (m)} sets the initial translation of rotorcraft zeros, {Initial rotation (rad)} sets the rotorcraft rotation zeros, {Scale source}, {Initial scale} sets the initial mesh scale, {Scale} sets the mesh scale, {Enable altitude and WoW sensors} sets the altitude and WoW sensors, {Show sensor rays in viewer} sets the option to show sensor rays, {Interpret vector outputs as 1-D} controls reshaping on sensor output ports, {Length of rays (m)}, {Rotorcraft body Z offset (m)}, {Ground-contact location 1 (m)} sets the first ground contact location, {Ground-contact location 2 (m)} sets the second ground contact location, {Ground-contact location 3 (m)} sets the third ground contact location, {Ground-contact location 4 (m)} sets the fourth ground contact location, {Front tire radius (m)} sets the front gear tire radius, {Left tire radius (m)} sets the left gear tire radius, {Right tire radius (m)} sets the right gear tire radius, {WoW sensor tolerance (m)} sets the wow sensor tolerance, {Light configuration}, {Landing light intensity (cd)} sets the landing lights intensity, {Landing light cone half angle (deg)} sets the landing lights cone half angle, {Landing light color [r g b]} sets the landing light color, {Landing light location}, {Landing light orientation (deg)} sets the landing light orientation, {Nose light intensity (cd)} sets the nose lights intensity, {Nose light cone half angle (deg)}, {Nose light location}, {Nose light orientation (deg)} sets the nose light orientation, {Navigation lights intensity}, {Position light intensity}, {Strobe light intensity}, {Strobe color [r g b]} sets the strobe color, {Strobe period (s)}, {Strobe pulse width (% of period)}, {Beacon light intensity}, {Beacon color [r g b]} sets the beacon color, {Beacon period (s)} and {Beacon pulse width (% of period)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type
params.values: Rotorcraft type Light helicopter (default) | Helicopter | Multirotor

params.name: Path to light helicopter mesh
params.values: Path to light helicopter mesh ’/MathWorksAerospaceContent/Vehicles/Rotorcraft/LightHelicopter/Mesh/SK_LightHelicopter.SK_LightHelicopter’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Path to helicopter mesh
params.values: Path to helicopter mesh ’/MathWorksAerospaceContent/Vehicles/Rotorcraft/Helicopter/Mesh/SK_Helicopter.SK_Helicopter’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Path to multirotor mesh
params.values: Path to multirotor mesh ’/MathWorksAerospaceContent/Vehicles/Rotorcraft/Multirotor/Mesh/SK_Quadcopter.SK_Quadcopter’ (default) | ’/MathWorksAerospaceContent/Vehicles/Rotorcraft/Multirotor/Mesh/SK_QuadcopterMini.SK_QuadcopterMini’ | character vector

params.name: Color
params.values: Rotorcraft color Red (default) | Orange | Yellow | Green | Cyan | Blue | Black | White | Silver | Metal

params.name: Initial translation (m)
params.values: Initial translation of rotorcraft zeros(6,3) (default) | 19-by-3 array | 11-by-3 array
